items.text: In three long-term care homes, can monthly interdisciplinary deprescribing rounds with a named deputy and a protected slot be adopted and sustained through 2027, what proportion of residents do they reach within six months, and what proportion of recommendations are carried out within four weeks?
items.population: Residents of three long-term care homes (168 beds) and the staff who run the rounds
items.intervention: Monthly interdisciplinary deprescribing rounds with a checklist, a named deputy and a protected slot
items.outcome: Adoption, reach, implementation of recommendations and sustainability (RE-AIM), with falls and restarts as balancing measures
items.setting: Three homes of one non-profit operator

finer: Feasible with 0.4 FTE pharmacist time and routine records; interesting to the operator; novel locally; ethical under determination QA-2026-077 with residents' wishes respected; relevant because the operator decides on continuation at the end of 2027.
summary: One implementation question with RE-AIM outcomes.
